user.title: Tab5 — Home Assistant files
user.description:
This integration installs the Home Assistant files of the M5Stack Tab5 project (packages, templates, blueprint) and replaces them at each update made through HACS. The old files are kept in `tab5_sauvegardes/`. Your own packages, templates and blueprints are never touched.

Needed once in `configuration.yaml`, if it is not there yet:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

data_description.mettre_a_jour_tablette: Once the files are in place, install the firmware of the same version as soon as the tablet's « Firmware » entity offers it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The Tab5 integration is already added.

data.reinstaller: Install the files of this version again now

data_description.mettre_a_jour_tablette: Once the files are in place, install the firmware of the same version as soon as the tablet's « Firmware » entity offers it.
data_description.reinstaller: For a Tab5 file deleted or edited by mistake. The current ones are saved first.
data_description.assistant: Prepares the screen slots automation from your Home Assistant areas. Nothing is written until you confirm; an existing automation only changes if you ask for it.

pieces.title: Assistant · rooms
pieces.description: The assistant prepares the screen slots automation (blueprint « Tab5 — emplacements de l'écran · screen slots ») from your Home Assistant areas. {nombre} area(s) have devices the tablet can show; the best equipped are already picked, {max} at most. Nothing is written before the summary.

data_description.pieces: Five at most, in the order of the bottom row's pages: the first on the home page, the next ones a swipe away.

piece.title: Assistant · room {numero} of {total}: {zone}
piece.description: Filled in from the Home Assistant area « {zone} »: its lights, covers, switches, fans and media players ({max} at most), its temperature and humidity sensors and its climate. Change anything you like.

data_description.nom: Empty: the area its devices share.
data_description.tuiles: Five at most, left to right.
data_description.temperature: Optional. Shown on the home page while this room is on screen.
data_description.clim: Optional, with the temperature: the home page's − / + buttons adjust it.

data.mettre_a_jour: Replace the rooms of the existing automation

data_description.mettre_a_jour: Its other settings (weather, energy, gestures…) stay as they are.

abort.aucune_piece: No Home Assistant area has a device the tablet can show: the assistant has nothing to offer and changes nothing. Assign your devices to areas in Home Assistant, then start it again (Settings → Devices & services → Tab5 → Configure, box « Start the setup assistant »), or fill in the blueprint's automation by hand.

fichiers_absents.title: Tab5: no Home Assistant files in the integration
fichiers_absents.description: The Tab5 integration {version} carries no files: it was copied from the repository instead of being installed from a release. Install it through HACS (custom repository), which downloads `tab5_hacs.zip` from the release.

configuration_invalide.title: Tab5: the files {version} were not installed
configuration_invalide.description: The new Tab5 files could not be put in place (the configuration check found an error with them, or writing them failed), so the previous files were put back and nothing changed. The reason is in the log (Settings → System → Logs, « tab5 »). After a configuration error, these files are not tried again at each restart: once the cause is fixed, use Settings → Devices & services → Tab5 → Configure, « Install the files of this version again now ». If the cause is not in your own files, please report it: {signaler}

packages_absents.title: Tab5: Home Assistant does not load the packages
packages_absents.description:
The Tab5 files are in `config/packages/`, but Home Assistant does not read that folder. Add these two lines to `configuration.yaml` (the `homeassistant:` line only once), check the configuration, then restart:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
```

redemarrage_requis.title: Tab5: restart Home Assistant to finish

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Tab5 files {version} are in place, but some of them only take effect after a restart. Submit to restart Home Assistant now.

error.configuration_invalide: The configuration has an error: fix it first (Developer tools → YAML → Check configuration).

fichiers_remplaces.title: Tab5: files already there were replaced

confirm.title: Tab5 files already there were replaced
confirm.description:
These Tab5 files were already in `config/` (copied by hand, most likely) and differed from those of the release: {fichiers}. They were replaced anyway, and the old ones are kept in {sauvegarde}. If you had changed one of them on purpose, copy your change back from there.

Submit to close this message.

firmware_echec.title: Tab5: the tablet did not update to {version}
firmware_echec.description: The Tab5 files {version} are in place, but the tablet still runs another version after {essais} tries of its update. Install it by hand: Settings → Updates (or the tablet's « Firmware » entity) → Install, with the tablet on and connected. The reason of each try is in the log (Settings → System → Logs, « tab5 »). This message goes away once the tablet runs {version}.
